assertions.text: Since `min_rounds` is already satisfied but `max_rounds` isn't, describes a single AskUserQuestion call carrying two questions -- not a single combined question, not two separate calls, not skipping straight to posting
Correctly describes this as the first trigger-ask in the conversation, so it must actually ask rather than reuse a prior answer

Question 1 is multi-select with one option per enabled reviewer (Codex, CodeRabbit, Devin) plus an explicit "No further round for now" option, never exceeding the 4-option cap; Question 2 is single-select with exactly 2 options ("Default review"/"Full review") applied uniformly to whichever reviewer(s) Question 1 selects -- explicitly not a default-vs-full pair of options per reviewer in Question 1

States that if "No further round for now" is selected in Question 1, Question 2's answer is ignored and nothing is posted; and that after both questions are answered, each selected reviewer's resolved trigger string gets validated (tracked-ness gate, then regex, then handle-token match) before anything is posted, with this same decision reused for round 3 without asking again
